commercial.case_study_claim: Built an evolutionary solver portfolio that reached #1 on the public OPTIL.io Jobshop scheduling benchmark against a real incumbent field.
commercial.offer: Build or audit a finite-capacity production scheduling optimizer and demonstrate measurable schedule-quality improvements on the client constraints.

canary.promotion_rule: Promote only if a legal generic baseline submission is valid and scores at least 97.0, then require monotonic gain across the next two survivor submissions.

donors.contribution: CP-SAT job-shop model and search controls
modern job-shop CP models, warm starts, objectives
dispatching, simulated annealing, CP-SAT and learning-based policies

evolution.weakness_hypothesis: The public field is only 22 users and the incumbent aggregate score is 99.70 rather than 100.00; a modern generic portfolio combining CP-SAT, dispatching, and local-search donors can search per-instance tradeoffs that the current single incumbent configuration does not simultaneously dominate.

execution.carrier: C++/Python optimization solver submitted to OPTIL judge

notes: Live browser readback at observation time: Krzysiek C++ 99.70 / 2934.77s; swats 98.45; KarolinaK 97.03. Submit enabled with 20-minute cooldown. Crown language must be precise: #1 on OPTIL.io Jobshop, not global proof of optimality for all JSSP.

prestige.institution_or_platform: OPTIL.io / Poznan University of Technology optimization judge

probability.basis: Live standing shows 22 users with #1 at 99.70 and #2 at 98.45, leaving a nonzero quality gap; donor density is strong and commercial mapping is direct, but the final 0.30 points may be genuinely difficult and local instance reproduction has not yet been assayed.
